data.name: Bijender
data.gender_notes: Bijender is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bijender is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'bij' meaning seed and 'andh' meaning to conquer. This name is given to a boy who is believed to have the power to conquer and grow new things, like a seed that sprouts and becomes a plant. In Hindu mythology, the god Vishnu is often depicted as the one who plants the seeds of creation and nurtures them into existence.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodying the power of creation and growth.
data.etymology: Bijender belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Conqueror of Bija (Seeds).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bijender total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
